note: Late night came back to life this week. The Daily Show ended its five-week summer hiatus with Jon Stewart hosting a rare Tuesday episode (Labor Day pushed his usual Monday slot back a day); Kimmel and Fallon returned too, just in time for the GOP's midterm convention in Dallas. Seth Meyers is still out until September 21.

videos.title: Trump Tries to Bribe His Way into GOP Midterm Win During Two-Hour-Long Speech

jokes.topic: Kimmel's own first night back from his summer break (Sep 8), on how little Trump got done while he was gone
jokes.joke: Donald Trump and I have one thing in common. We both accomplished nothing all summer long.
jokes.context: Followed with a jab that the only thing Trump did get done was his hair.

jokes.topic: Returning from a five-week break and catching up on everything Trump did in August (rolling back childhood vaccine requirements, threatening to demolish the Kennedy Center, attacking mail-in voting)
jokes.joke: God, it never ends with this dude Trump. I've never seen one person work so much and fix so little.
jokes.context: His first episode back, and a rare Tuesday hosting slot since Labor Day bumped his usual Monday.

jokes.topic: A viral trailer for Nathan Fielder's Elizabeth Holmes documentary "You Can See Everything"
jokes.joke: Why would I deceive you? There's no — there's no reason for me to do that.
jokes.context: Superimposed Trump's face onto Fielder's body in the doctored trailer, using it to compare Trump aide Natalie Harp — nicknamed "the human printer" for constantly feeding him positive news printouts — to Holmes.

jokes.topic: Trump promising every American $5,000 if Republicans sweep the midterms
jokes.joke: I know that sounds like a bribe. In Trump's defense, he's never going to pay us, so technically it's not a bribe.
jokes.context: Part of his coverage of the GOP's midterm convention in Dallas.

jokes.topic: Trump's two-hour address at the convention
jokes.joke: Two hours is not so much a speech — that's a residency.

jokes.topic: An Air Force One emergency slide accidentally deploying, delaying Trump's flight to the convention and forcing him to wait aboard Marine One
jokes.joke: Once again, Trump is causing more inflation.
